svg.aria-label: Left: level curves of the quadratic Lyapunov function V = x transpose P x for dx/dt = Ax with A = [0 1; −1 −0.5], where P solves the Lyapunov equation with Q = I. The trajectory from (2, 0) cuts every level curve inwards. Right: V along the trajectory decreases monotonically to zero
